schema_version.description: Request contract version; must be 1 when present.

repository.description: Absolute path of the Git repository to analyse. Defaults to the caller's workspace root; never inferred from the tool cwd.

base.description: Base revision (branch, tag, or commit). Omitted: the merge base of HEAD and the branch the work lands on (its upstream, else origin/HEAD, else main, else master); the choice is reported in result.default_base. Nothing is fetched.

head.description: Head revision. Omitted: the working tree, including staged, unstaged, and untracked (not ignored) files, which is never cached. Requires base.

symbols.description: Changed-symbol selectors (symbol:<path>#<name>:<kind>) to analyse; default every changed symbol up to max_symbols. A selector that matches no changed symbol is listed in result.unmatched_selection.

confidence.description: Minimum resolution confidence of every hop: exact, import_resolved, same_module, or fuzzy_name (name-only matches). Default same_module.

depth.description: Maximum hops from a changed symbol to a caller or entry point; 1-10, default 3.

node_cap.description: Maximum nodes, and paths, one traversal may return; 1-2000, default 200.

query_budget_ms.description: Wall-clock budget of one traversal in milliseconds; 100-60000, default 5000. Capped at the time left in budget_ms.

max_symbols.description: Maximum changed symbols analysed, in changed-symbol order; 1-1000, default 25. The rest are listed in result.not_analysed.

max_callers.description: Maximum callers kept per changed symbol, strongest evidence first; 1-500, default 5.

max_entry_points.description: Maximum entry points kept per changed symbol, nearest first; 1-100, default 3.

max_tests.description: Maximum candidate tests kept per changed symbol, strongest source first; 1-500, default 5.

budget_ms.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole call, indexing included, in milliseconds; 1000-110000, default 90000, below the 120 s tool timeout. When it runs out the call returns complete: false with the reason instead of hanging.

language.description: Keep only changed symbols whose file is in this language (for example rust).

scope.description: Keep only changed symbols whose path starts with this prefix.
